faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Gurdaspur District Court Lift Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Gurdaspur District Court Lift Operator recruitment is 24th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Lift Operator post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Lift Operator post in the Gurdaspur District Court recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for the Lift Operator position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Lift Operator position is 18 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Lift Operator post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Lift Operator post is 37 years, with relaxation applicable as per Punjab Government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Lift Operator role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have Matriculation or equivalent, ITI in electrical trade, or five years of experience in lift operation and maintenance.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Lift Operator position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for the Lift Operator post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Lift Operator post will be as per the rates fixed by the Deputy Commissioner from time to time.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Gurdaspur District Court, which is http://districts.ecourts.gov.in/gurdaspur.
